section.title: The headline
section.p: Fugu is the fractality thesis, shipped and benchmark-leading: orchestrating a heterogeneous frontier pool beats every constituent (10/11 benchmarks, SWE-Bench Pro 73.7 vs Opus 4.8's 69.2) — while lacking exactly our planes: runtime budgets/cost accounting (turn caps only, w_cost=0), routing transparency (proprietary, unsteerable), escalation-to-human (absent), durable artifacts. Its one loss (MRCRv2 long-context) argues FOR Stage B's descent core: conducting and descent are complementary axes. Named mechanisms adopted: orchestration collapse → isolation by default; access lists → `context_from`; verifier-accept completion + cold-verifier suppression; availability masking; soft-label routing tables from measured outcomes.
